description: An unknown tuple of a string and a dynamic element converts to an unknown set of strings
notes: The dynamic pseudo-type unifies with string by selecting string. go-cty has the conversion from the dynamic pseudo-type to string only among its unsafe conversions, which it uses to unify the element types of an unknown tuple here (dynamicReplace in cty/convert/conversion_dynamic.go). Like native/types/convert-unknown-tuple-with-dynamic-element-to-list-of-any, with a set of any in place of the list of any.
